# Amineddine Znin

> Amineddine Znin is a Morocco-based software developer, freelancer and cybersecurity builder, available for work globally. He builds production websites with Next.js, React and TypeScript, security & detection-engineering tooling with Python, MITRE ATT&CK and Sigma, and AI-automation systems for businesses.

## The site

A portfolio presented as a Netflix-style experience. The same body of work is narrated through three "profiles" — Recruiter, Developer, and Curious — and offered in English and French. Content is identical across profiles; only the tone changes.

- https://amineddine.online/ — entry / profile picker
- https://amineddine.online/browse/recruiter — hiring-focused view
- https://amineddine.online/browse/developer — engineering-focused view
- https://amineddine.online/browse/stalker — casual, plain-language view

## Selected web projects

- **Moroccan Mirage** (https://moroccanmirage.com) — Full-stack, cinematic luxury-travel website with a custom trip planner and dynamic tour catalog. Next.js, React, TypeScript, Framer Motion, Lenis.
- **GoGestion** (https://gogestion-dusky.vercel.app) — Website for a group operating ten prestige riads across the Marrakech medina, unified as one luxury collection. Next.js, French-first.
- **Visitare il Marocco** (https://visitareilmarocco.vercel.app) — Italian-language site for a tourism agency bringing Italian travellers to Morocco.
- **Automate** (https://automate.ma) — Self-initiated AI-automation venture for Moroccan businesses; custom AI agents and workflows.
- **WeFrame Media** (https://www.weframemedia.com/) — Premium creative-agency website for a Marrakech video studio.
- **The Seven Saints** (https://ornate-marigold-5e0674.netlify.app/) — Luxury desert-camp website for an Agafay stay.
- **Mahal Films** (https://www.mahalfilms.com/) — Production-services platform for international shoots in Morocco.

## Selected security projects (open source)

- **SigmaPack-Builder** — Python pipeline converting ATT&CK-tagged detections into deploy-ready Sigma-style YAML rule packs. https://github.com/Amineddine/SigmaPack-Builder
- **soar-mini-enricher** — FastAPI alert-enrichment microservice: maps alerts to MITRE ATT&CK, scores severity, returns analyst recommendations. https://github.com/Amineddine/soar-mini-enricher
- **attck-tagger** — Explainable, rule-based ATT&CK enrichment for JSONL security logs with confidence scores. https://github.com/Amineddine/attck-tagger
- **rareguard** (research) — Self-supervised Transformer for rare security-log anomalies with conformal p-values for calibrated alerts. https://github.com/Amineddine/rareguard
